nodes.question: How have smart solutions like tracing apps proven effective during crisis conditions such as the COVID-19 pandemic?
nodes.answer: Smart solutions like tracing apps have been widely used to control the spread of COVID-19 by enabling contact tracing, monitoring infected individuals, and notifying potential contacts, thus helping to curb the transmission of the virus and manage the outbreak.
